empty: No configurable items in this section

logLevelHints.Verbose: Logs everything, including every SQL statement and request detail. For short troubleshooting only; left on, it fills the disk quickly.
logLevelHints.Debug: Logs debugging details. Turn it on while investigating; not recommended day to day.
logLevelHints.Information: Logs the normal business flow. The default level.
logLevelHints.Warning: Logs only warnings and errors; the normal flow is not written.
logLevelHints.Error: Logs only errors. You may miss clues that are wrong without raising an error.
logLevelHints.Fatal: Logs only failures that stop the process. Almost the same as turning logging off.
